title: FDUSD launch and issuer context
description: First Digital introduced FDUSD as a USD stablecoin product. SOG records this as launch and issuer context, with reserve-report and jurisdiction details kept separate.

title: FDUSD exchange-adoption context during BUSD phase-out
description: Binance's BUSD phase-out period increased the visibility of alternative stablecoins including FDUSD. SOG records this as exchange-adoption context, not as issuer redemption status.

title: PayPal launches PYUSD
description: PayPal launched PayPal USD, issued by Paxos. SOG records this as launch, issuer, reserve-report, and app-access context for PYUSD.

title: PYUSD expands to Solana
description: PayPal USD became available on Solana. SOG records this as deployment and chain-expansion context separate from issuer reserve reports and redemption access.

title: USDD launch context
description: USDD launched as a TRON DAO Reserve-associated stablecoin. SOG records this as launch, reserve, collateral, and protocol context requiring continued source review.
